# Babylon Tours

> > Babylon Tours offers expertly guided walking tours and museum experiences in major cities including Florence, Paris, London, New York, and Washington DC, featuring cultural landmarks and world-renowned art collections.

Babylon Tours specializes in small-group and semi-private guided tours across iconic destinations, with skip-the-line access to museums like the Accademia (Michelangelo's David), British Museum, and Smithsonian institutions. The company also provides travel insights through their blog, covering personal growth through travel, cultural experiences, and practical advice for travelers.

## Key Topics

- Guided walking tours
- Museum tours with skip-the-line access
- Small-group and semi-private experiences
- Florence (Accademia, Duomo, Medici history)
- Paris (Père Lachaise, Les Invalides, Musée d'Orsay)
- London (Westminster, British Museum, Natural History Museum)
- New York City (Midtown Manhattan, Central Park, Metropolitan Museum)
- Washington DC (Smithsonian museums)
- Amsterdam (Van Gogh Museum, NEMO Science Museum, Dam Square)
- Cultural immersion and experiences
- Travel benefits and personal growth
- Art history (Rembrandt, Vermeer, Michelangelo, Brunelleschi)
- Historical landmarks and monuments
- Solo travel and adventure travel
- Travel philosophy and lifestyle

## Featured City Tours

- [Florence City Center & Accademia Tour](https://babylontours.com/florence/city-center-accademia-michaelangelos-david-guided-tour): Skip-the-line Accademia tour featuring Michelangelo's David in Florence
- [History of Florence Exclusive Walking Tour](https://babylontours.com/florence/history-of-florence-exclusive-walking-tour): Florence walking tour: Duomo, Ponte Vecchio, Medici history with experts
- [Midtown Manhattan Guided Walking Tour](https://babylontours.com/nyc/midtown-manhattan-guided-walking-tour): Walking tour of Midtown Manhattan landmarks: Times Square, Fifth Avenue
- [Hisory of London - City Center Westminster Guided Walking Tour](https://babylontours.com/london/history-london-city-center-westminster-guided-tour): Westminster walking tour: Big Ben, 10 Downing Street, Trafalgar Square
- [National Museum of Natural History + American History Museum Tour](https://babylontours.com/washington-dc/natural-history-american-history-museum-tour): Combo Smithsonian tour: Natural History + American History museums in DC

## Museum & Cultural Tours

- [British Museum + National Gallery of London Guided Tour](https://babylontours.com/london/british-museum-national-gallery-guided-tour): Combo tour: British Museum Rosetta Stone + National Gallery art history
- [Natural History Museum of London Tour](https://babylontours.com/london/natural-history-museum-guided-tour): Guided tour of London Natural History Museum featuring Hope the Blue Whale
- [Les Invalides War Museum Guided Tour](https://babylontours.com/paris/les-invalides-war-museum-guided-tour): Skip-the-line tour of Les Invalides and Musée de l'Armée in Paris
- [Père Lachaise Cemetery Guided Walking Tour](https://babylontours.com/paris/pere-lachaise-cemetery-guided-tour): Guided tour of Père Lachaise Cemetery featuring Jim Morrison, Édith Piaf
